search_window.basis: Prior read-back-verified heartbeat completed at 02:48:09 PST; target newly reported/discovered disruptions through this observation, screening actual incident and publication dates rather than index date.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value miss-class recall only; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
classes_checked: Loss, closure, fire, or disaster affecting only, sole, last, or full-service community grocery
Cancellation or suspension of emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
Abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "sole grocery store" burned down OR closed 2026 October 31
"food pantry" emergency closure power outage October 31 November 1 2026
site:gov SNAP EBT benefits outage delayed November 1 2026 statewide notice
site:gov WIC benefits interruption outage November 1 2026
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted searches completed and produced usable results; no new qualifying U.S. disruption with support placing the development after the prior observation was verified. Searches were dominated by 2025 SNAP shutdown stories, older grocery closures, out-of-scope service expansions, and existing preannounced changes.

excluded_examples.title: Virginia EBT notice of November 1, 2026 sweetened-beverage eligibility change
excluded_examples.reason: Previously announced change in eligible products, explicitly no effect on benefit amount; not a newly issued emergency interruption.

excluded_examples.title: Pennsylvania 2025 federal-shutdown SNAP interruption notice
excluded_examples.reason: Notice dated October 20, 2025; not a new November 2026 incident.

excluded_examples.title: Provo Utah food-bank closure previously reported in prior recall watch
excluded_examples.reason: Already recorded as an earlier candidate; avoid duplicates.

coverage_notes.limitations: Index latency and nonindexed official/provider updates can conceal very recent local incidents; absence of search evidence does not prove absence of incidents. Search results provided little genuinely current local coverage.
coverage_notes.production_authority: Production collection remains authoritative. No approvals, publication, schedule changes, or disabling were performed.
